trade_signal_doctrine.entry_logic: Preemptive entry at predicted wick-rejection zone (defensive staff) with tight SL; no waiting for confirmation.
confluences: Confluence 1: Price has retraced into the HTF discount zone, directly mitigating the H4 bullish order block and demand zone (SMC). This zone is reinforced by the 78000 major quarter level (Quarter Theory), which acts as a psychological barrier. The bullish H4 trend (EMA50/200) ensures that this retracement is a high-probability buy-on-dip opportunity, where institutional buyers are expected to defend the trend.

Confluence 2: The H4 wick rejection at 78120.74 establishes a strong MSNR support level and defines the lower boundary of the current candle range (CRT). This level aligns with an unmitigated H1 FVG. The high M15 ATR of 238.78 indicates that any downward spike into this zone will experience high volatility, leading to a rapid preemptive wick-rejection as liquidity is swept and orders are filled.

Confluence 3: The price is forming a potential double bottom pattern on the H1/H4 timeframes by retesting the 78120-78165 support (Chart Patterns). The M5 timeframe shows immediate wick rejection at 78165.27 (Candlestick Patterns), indicating buying pressure. This setup is supported by the M15 RSI at 37.2, which shows momentum is reaching oversold exhaustion, preparing for a bullish reversal to continue the HTF bullish structure (BOS).

Confluence 4: A liquidity sweep of the short-term lows is occurring just above the 78000 major quarter level (SMC), tapping into the H4 demand zone (Supply & Demand). The volume is showing signs of selling climax (exhaustion) as price approaches the defensive staff zone. This indicates that the bearish momentum is running out of fuel, and the preemptive buy-limit order will capture the exact turning point as market makers absorb the remaining sell orders.

Confluence 5: The retracement to 78165.27 represents a 70.1% Fibonacci retracement (Optimal Trade Entry zone) of the swing from 76838 to 81272. This level is at a -2 Standard Deviation extension from the short-term mean (SD), indicating an extreme oversold condition. As the candle range theory (CRT) predicts a range expansion back to the mean, the RSI momentum exhaustion confirms that the price is primed for a sharp upward bounce from the defensive staff.

confidence_model.dominant_bias_reason: HTF trend is strongly bullish, and price has retraced to the OTE zone (70.1% retracement) and a major H4 demand zone/wick rejection level at 78120.74. LTF momentum is exhausted (M15 RSI 37.2) and high volatility (M15 ATR 238.78) supports a sharp preemptive wick rejection at the defensive staff.

risk_profile.note: Preemptive entry captures full HTF continuation without waiting for wick confirmation.
